subject: LOUD: `builtin::indexed` (perl 5.36+, stable in 5.40) is not implemented -- `use builtin 'indexed'` imports nothing (a name the runtime lacks is skipped silently) and the first `indexed(LIST)` dies "Undefined subroutine &main::indexed" (Rosetta 0294 0119)
